gates.reason: Requires the host Docker image, whose build (Dockerfile line 85-89) mounts nuget_github_actor/nuget_github_token BuildKit secrets to restore the sibling-repository package feed. Those secrets are not available in this session, so the image cannot be built. Docker itself is available locally.
